item.title: Breathing and Posture for Singing
item.description: Find your voice and sing with confidence, one steady breath at a time. Lesson 1: Breathing and Posture for Singing This lesson teaches you how to breathe and stand for singing. Everything later in this course - holding long notes, singing in tune, shaping clear words - builds directly on the…

item.title: Finding Your Range
item.description: Lesson 2: Finding Your Range This lesson teaches you to find your vocal range: the span of notes you can sing comfortably, from your lowest easy note to your highest easy note. Knowing your range is practical, not a label - it tells you which songs will sit comfortably for your voice, which notes…

item.title: Pitch and Ear Training
item.description: Lesson 3: Pitch and Ear Training This lesson teaches you to match pitch accurately and to hear musical distances - intervals - by ear. Pitch is the foundation of singing in tune: if you can hear a note clearly and reproduce it with your voice, you can sing any melody. Ear training is simply the…

item.title: Warming Up Safely
item.description: Lesson 4: Warming Up Safely This lesson teaches you to warm up safely: gentle exercises that prepare your voice for singing without strain. A warm-up is not a performance - it is a slow, easy stretch for the voice, like walking before running. Singers who warm up regularly find their voices respond…

item.title: Vowels and Diction - Singing Words Clearly
item.description: Lesson 5: Vowels and Diction - Singing Words Clearly This lesson teaches you to shape vowels and pronounce words clearly while singing. In speech, vowels carry the sound and consonants carry the meaning; in singing, the same is true, but the balance shifts - vowels need to stay open and ringing so…

item.title: Singing a Simple Song from Start to Finish
item.description: Lesson 6: Singing a Simple Song from Start to Finish This lesson teaches you to sing a complete song from start to finish: learning it in sections, mapping your breaths, and putting the sections together into a performance you can be proud of. Singing a whole song is a milestone - it is the moment…

item.title: Harmony Basics - Singing with Others
item.description: Lesson 7: Harmony Basics - Singing with Others This lesson teaches you harmony basics: singing a second part above or below a melody while someone else sings the main tune. Harmony is what makes group singing sound rich - two voices moving together, each on its own line, blending into a sound…

item.title: Your Daily Practice Routine + What to Learn Next
item.description: Lesson 8: Your Daily Practice Routine + What to Learn Next This lesson builds your permanent daily practice routine and maps out where to go next.
